title: Fixed Pedestal Styling Chair
description: Original fixed-pose salon styling chair with a broad flat-bottomed tapered pedestal, fixed two-stage column, seat mounting block, padded seat and back, two armrests with genuine open-side supports, and a forward foot platform carried by two sloped struts and a crossmember. Distinct professional seat structure, original low-poly silhouette and muted upholstery/metal finish. Independently editable parts in one static asset. No hydraulic lift, swivel, recline, load rating, electrical or ergonomic certification.
